description: Persist a partial patch to ~/.delx-wellness/profile.json. Requires explicit_user_intent=true (otherwise returns USER_ACTION_REQUIRED). Validates known v1 fields, types and enums; rejects malformed stored profiles without overwriting them. Rejects secret-like fields (oauth, token, secret, password, cookie, refresh, api_key, session) at write time. Use to record preferred name, goals, devices, training context, nutrition context, exercise preferences, agent preferences, and safety flags.

explicit_user_intent.description: Must be true to persist. Prevents accidental writes from agent inference.

patch.description: Partial WellnessProfileDocument patch. Only profile, goals, devices, training, nutrition, preferences, safety, notes are writable. Nested fields must match the v1 types and enums; null and unknown fields are rejected.

name: withings_profile_update
title: Update Delx Wellness Profile
